data.one_liner: Convert native camera stream image formats like nv21 or bgra8888 into jpeg files or bytes.
data.what_it_does: Provides a utility to convert single plane native image formats from camera streams (such as ImageFormatGroup.nv21 or ImageFormatGroup.bgra8888) into JPEG files or memory bytes. Useful when processing camera frames with ML Kit or similar libraries and saving the exact frame.
use_when: You need to save or convert camera stream frames (nv21 or bgra8888) into JPEG format
You are processing camera frames with ML Kit and want to capture the processed frame
avoid_when: You are not working with camera stream images or native formats
You need complex video recording or streaming functionality
strengths: Simple utility specifically targeting camera stream native formats
Supports converting directly to memory bytes or files
weaknesses: Very early version (0.0.1) with minimal documentation and a TODO changelog
Limited to specific image format groups
